Class UserProfilePayload

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.security.extension.userdetails.UserProfilePayload
public class UserProfilePayload extends Object
Carrier object that exposes the user's profile information to API clients.

This POJO is used to serialise the SecurityPrincipal (and the underlying JWT payload) into a transport-friendly representation that is documented through Swagger annotations. It is intentionally mutable so that it can be populated from various authentication back-ends while still benefiting from Lombok-generated getters, setters, equals, hashCode and toString via the Data annotation.

Each field is mapped to a swagger property via ApiModelProperty so the resulting JSON contract is self-describing.
